verification.source: EEA, CO2 emissions from new passenger cars (discodata, CO2Emission.latest.co2cars)
verification.norway: model seen among new registrations in Norway 2019-2022
verification.europeCountries: number of other European countries where the model was newly registered 2010-2022
verification.limits: No Norwegian data before 2019 and no data at all before 2010 or after 2022: a missing flag means 'not confirmed', never 'not sold there'.

meta.note: Selection list only. Years are first-registration years seen in the Dutch register. No service data; does not identify engine, gearbox or market.
